in_sanskrit.name: Ajijur
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Radiant warrior
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ajijur एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ajijur is derived from Sanskrit roots ‘aji’ meaning radiant and ‘jur’ meaning warrior. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the god Indra, who is considered the god of war, rain, and thunder. Ajijur represents the courage, strength, and power of a warrior, as well as the radiance and brilliance that shines from within.
